author: Phobiaxx
body:
Purpose: to make a mod's life easier, and to bring down the amount of people with infractions.
NOTE:Please tell me if any of these are implemented already..
List:
Short-Term[Easy to Implement,or should be]
Cloaking Ability[Moderator +]{Medium Priority} Allow them to /vanish from everyone, aside from other staff of the same level+, only when they are in spectator mode.

Follow Ability[Jr.Mod+]{Low Priority}Allow them to /follow <player> instead of having staff having to break their hands on the keyboard following accused players, let them automatically follow the player, 3 blocks behind, and 2 above, to stop, they can /unfollow.
Complicated Part: Also, they can /hfollow, where it is basically like xray mode, only showing players and their items. When following in hfollow, they can pass through walls, as if it were air, and stay in them, but still see the player. mode can be halted by /unfollow. [USE netox_max's description post below]

Cuss Follower[Jr. Mod+]{Medium Priority} mode can be toggled with /cf on, /cf off. Before the avicore update, all cuss words were censored, now they show, if possible, configure this, to send staff with cf mode cuss feed, where the system senses players using the words:(F*ck, B*tch) In the feed, it shows the entire line, so if Rudeplayer1 says:hey! F*ck you! Mods see CF:Rudeplayer1>hey!F*ck you!

[BugFix]{Medium Priority}-make it so staff dont have to kick to "enforce  a ban" when players are banned, make it so when staff /ban or /tempban a player, they are also /kicked automatically(doesn't show on infraction page) 6 seconds after, just in case, they are only kicked to the hub.

InfractionCheck[Jr.Mod+]{Medium Priority}with this, staff can /ic <player> to see the previous infractions of the player, to make it easier to decide how to punish a player, without having to go on a browser.

AdFeed[Mod+]{Low Priority}toggled with /adc on, /adc off. On a server I previously played on, they had a plugin to censor anything related to sites, ips, etc, by prohibiting things with multiple "." or .com, .net, etc, instead of doing that, it would be good if there was a feed for ads/inappropriate sites. Have the system detect whenever a PLAYER says something with .com, .net, or multiple "."s leave the staff members out of the feed range. Most of it probably will just people saying "avicus.net" or so, for innapropriate sites, to save the staff's eyes and ears, it would be great if in adfeed mode, when links are clicked, instead of going to the site, it would look the site up on google or something, to see what it's about.

MEDIUM-TERM:
Hacker Feed[Mod+]{High Priority} mode can be toggled with /hf on, /hf off, since NCP already gives feed to OPs, tho a bit inaccurate, why not open it to mods+, with some configuring. Have the feed configured to just announce "aimbot,killaura,forcefield,autoclick, fly" instead of stuff like reach.far, also, configure it, so they show up more than once, unlike NCP, which it just shows once in, like forever, have it show once every 5 seconds, as long as they are using, like that, mods can also see which ones are inaccurate, (shows only once), or real, when they are spammed with reports of the same player.
However, avicus is so popular, I suggest only staff with fast computers use it..

HackerFeed[Mod+]{High Priority}to add to the previous, mods can /hf <player> when they receive a hack report, which would send all the feed of that player. mods can toggle this off with /hfs off
To Use: of course, NCP isn't reliable enough to /ban with just the feed, this is to save the mods the hassle from ragers, who accuse virtually everyone who kills them with hacks, with this, they can tell which is true, or not, of course, if mods would want to, they could still check out the reports with no backup feed.

That's it for now! Hope it's good, and get's accepted! Please comment any suggestions, your feedback, etc! :)

Bonus Question:Do staff have perms to message anyone they want to? If not...

[Permission]{Medium Priority}[Mod+]ability to /msg anyone in the whole server!

replies.author: Netuxx
replies.body:
Its really nice exept for a part of the follow thing.
You can't make a bukkit xray and make players go thru walls. You can also send a clientBlockChange. Whats that? Is just a message that the server send to the client saying that one block is changed when its not. So you can remove blocks around the player hacking only for the staff client.
